messages:
morgan: Quick thread — planning summit logistics. want to lock dates, facilitation owners, and minimal prework. proposing Wed/Thu June 10-11 (two half-days). thoughts?

alex: Those dates work for me. I can co-facilitate the roadmap sequencing session.

jamie: I can lead the customer-asks prioritization exercise. will prepare the intake template. need a slot ~90m.

sarah: I'm good for facilitation prep — I can consolidate prework and manage invites/travel stipend. do we want an in-person hub or fully hybrid? :thinking_face:

anika: hybrid is preferred. recommend SF HQ as hub + high-quality A/V so remote folks can pair into breakouts. i can book rooms if we decide.

morgan: OK — plan: 1) decide hub (SF HQ vs. Mountain View pop-up) 2) finalize run-of-show and facilitators 3) publish prework (1 pager + 2 prompts) 4) assign breakout owners and success criteria.

alex: suggested run-of-show draft: 
```
Day 1 (AM): company context & metrics, customer signals, cross-functional constraints (90m)
Day 1 (PM): Roadmap tradeoffs + initiative mapping (120m)
Day 2 (AM): OKR drafting + alignment (90m)
Day 2 (PM): Launch criteria & resourcing commitments + wrap (90m)
```
Short, focused breakouts between sessions.

jamie: For customer-asks triage I'll bring: top 10 asks from support + sales, example impact assessment, and a ~6 question intake form. want: prioritization rubric (cost, latency, revenue impact, strategic).

morgan: yes to rubric. proposal: rapid vote with weights, then 2-week spike owners for uncertain high-impact items.

sarah: Action items for logistics: RSVP by May 20, travel stipend policy doc, hotel block request. i need headcount by May 24.

anika: I'll scope AV & room needs. can we confirm headcount + preference (in-person vs remote) in the RSVP?

morgan: I'll draft the 1-pager prework: 
- What I want from you: 3 bullets (customer problem, proposed solution, rough cost)
- Role-specific questions for eng, product, sales
- A single signal metric to track after launch
Will share by end of week.

jamie: Template request: can be a Google Form + public sheet. i'll own the sheet and set up the initial tabs.

alex: Facilitation pairing: alex+morgan -> roadmap, jamie+anika -> customer triage, sarah -> logistics & opening/closing. sound good?

morgan: yep. owners noted.

calendar-bot: Event created: "Strategy Summit — Roadmap & OKRs" Tue Jun 10 09:00 - Jun 11 16:00 (Hybrid). Invite sent to channel. :calendar:

devrel-bot: Reminder scheduled: RSVP deadline May 20.

sarah: I'll post the travel stipend policy in #help and DM folks who asked about budgets.

morgan: two small asks before we close: 1) each facilitator drop 3 starter prompts for their session in this thread by EOD Fri 2) any customer asks to add to the intake sheet ping @jamie with a one-line rationale.

anika: will do. adding preliminary AV checklist to the shared doc.

alex: FYI: product-engineering roadmap spike owners — please be ready with capacity estimates for Q3. short bullets OK.

morgan: thanks all. i'll publish the run-of-show + prework link by Friday and follow up on facilitator prep call next Wed 30m. :thumbsup:
